historical_projects.title: Smart Attendance System using Facial Recognition

historical_projects.abstract: Scraping tweets using Tweepy, preprocessing with NLTK tokenizers, and calculating polarity scores using VADER sentiment analyzer.

historical_projects.abstract: Decentralized electronic health record storage utilizing IPFS for encrypted PDF files and Solidity smart contracts deployed on Ganache testnet.
